主要内容: The document is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, which includes information about the issuance of Senior Global Medium-Term Notes, Series F. The Notes include $850,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 2.150% Senior Notes, due March 06, 2020, and $550,000,000 aggregate principal amount of Senior Floating Rate Notes, due March 06, 2020. The filing includes various legal opinions and consents from Sullivan & Cromwell LLP and Norton Rose Fulbright Canada LLP regarding the validity of the Notes and related tax matters. The report was signed by James Salem, Executive Vice-President and Treasurer, on March 6, 2015.
